hero.heading: Build capability. Engineer progress.
hero.subheading: From the people on your shop floor to the systems that power it. One alliance for industrial training, automation engineering and workforce solutions.

services.title: Corporate Professional Training
services.description: Close the gap between knowing a system and confidently running it. Build a company-specific training programme around your equipment, team and operational priorities.
services.outcome: A practical learning plan built around your shop floor.
deliverables: Training needs assessment and tailored curriculum
Practical sessions on relevant industrial systems
Skill assessment and actionable learning feedback
Programme schedule aligned with your operations

services.title: Automation Services
services.description: Bring engineering expertise to the controls that keep production moving. Discuss a new automation requirement, system improvement or a troubleshooting challenge with our technical team.
services.outcome: From the control logic to the operator interface.
deliverables: PLC programming and control logic support

services.title: Industry-Ready Employees
services.description: Find technical people with practical automation exposure. Share your role requirements and connect with pre-vetted candidates whose capabilities fit your industrial environment.
services.outcome: Relevant technical talent for real industrial roles.

services.title: Training & Placement
services.description: Build practical skills and prepare for your next industry role. Our training and placement network supports freshers and experienced professionals looking to move forward in automation.
services.outcome: A clearer path from practical learning to industry interviews.
deliverables: Support for freshers and lateral candidates
